description: Defines the HttpRequestHeaders class for managing HTTP request headers, including header key/value pairs, iteration, and serialization.

classes.name: HttpRequestHeaders
classes.description: Manages HTTP request headers, allowing addition, removal, iteration, and serialization of headers.

classes.name: HeaderKeyValuePair
classes.description: Represents a key/value pair for HTTP headers.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Provides iteration over the headers in HttpRequestHeaders.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets or modifies a header key/value pair.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a header by key.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes headers into a string format.
